office_does: The three county commissioners adopt Lincoln County's budget, oversee roads and county services, and set county policy; each lives in and is nominated by a district but is elected county-wide.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Commissioner Rob Coffman, in office since 2010 and a past president of the Washington State Association of Counties, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: District 3 commissioner since 2010 and 2024 president of the Washington State Association of Counties; submitted no statement.
highlights: Commissioner since 2010; re-elected in 2022 over Jason DeBord [S3][S8]
Sworn in as Washington State Association of Counties president in 2024 [S6]
Cited unfunded state mandates and road and public-safety funding in 2022 [S4]
